package reflectdata
import("fmt";"encoding/json";"encoding/binary";"os";"slices";"testing";"IMPORT_TYPES";"IMPORT_IR";"IMPORT_OBJ";"IMPORT_SRC";"IMPORT_SYS";"IMPORT_TYPECHECK";"IMPORT_RTTYPE";"IMPORT_BITVEC";"IMPORT_TYPEBITS";RD_OBJW IMPORT_BASE IMPORT_BUILDCFG)
func TestSyncgoNativeSnapshot(t *testing.T){
 target:=struct{arch string;size int;order binary.ByteOrder}{os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"),8,binary.LittleEndian}
 switch target.arch{case "386":target.size=4;case "mips":target.size=4;target.order=binary.BigEndian;case "ppc64":target.order=binary.BigEndian}
 SETUP
 var out []string
 pos:=LINK.PosTable.XPos(src.MakePos(src.NewFileBase("p.go","/src/p.go"),7,3))
 named:=func(pkg *types.Pkg,name string,under *types.Type)*types.Type{n:=GRAPH.NewDeclNameAt(pos,ir.OTYPE,pkg.Lookup(name));typ:=TY.NewNamed(n);n.SetType(typ);n.SetTypecheck(1);typ.SetUnderlying(under);return typ}
 local:=named(TY.LocalPkg,"Local",TY.NewStruct(nil));foreign:=named(TY.NewPkg("example/dep","dep"),"Foreign",TY.NewStruct(nil))
 instantiated:=named(foreign.Sym().Pkg,"Generic[int]",TY.NewStruct(nil));instantiated.SetIsFullyInstantiated(true)
 shape:=named(TY.ShapePkg,"Shape",TY.NewStruct(nil));shape.SetHasShape(true)
 noalg:=TY.NewStruct([]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("X"),TY.Types[types.TINT])});noalg.SetNoalg(true)
 for _,typ:=range []*types.Type{TY.Types[types.TINT],TY.NewPtr(TY.ByteType),TY.NewPtr(TY.Types[types.TUINT8]),local,foreign,instantiated,noalg}{
  sym:=UP.TypeSym(typ);lsym:=UP.TypeLinksym(typ);UP.NeedRuntimeType(typ)
  out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("symbol:%v:%s:%s:%t:%t:%t:%s",typ,TY.TypeSymName(typ),lsym.Name,sym==TY.TypeSymLookup(sym.Name),lsym==UP.TypeLinksymLookup(sym.Name),lsym.TypeInfo().Type==typ,UP.TypeLinksymPrefix("eq",typ).Name))
 }
 wrappedError:=TY.NewSignature(nil,[]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,nil,TY.ErrorType)},[]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,nil,TY.Types[types.TSTRING])})
 for _,path:=range []string{"example/p","runtime"}{LINK.Pkgpath=path
 for _,typ:=range []*types.Type{TY.Types[types.TINT],TY.Types[types.TUNSAFEPTR],TY.AnyType,TY.ErrorType,TY.NewInterface(nil),TY.NewSlice(TY.Types[types.TINT]),wrappedError,local,foreign,instantiated,shape,noalg}{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("emit:%s:%v:%t",path,typ,UP.NeedEmit(typ)))}}
 LINK.Pkgpath="example/p"
 ptr:=UP.TypePtrAt(pos,local);lsym:=ptr.X.(*ir.LinksymOffsetExpr).Linksym
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("addr:%v:%v:%d:%t:%t",ptr,ptr.Type(),ptr.Typecheck(),ptr.Pos()==pos,lsym==UP.TypeLinksym(local)))
 from:=LINK.Lookup("p.F");UP.MarkTypeUsedInInterface(local,from);UP.MarkTypeSymUsedInInterface(UP.TypeLinksym(noalg),from)
 for _,r:=range from.R{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("reloc:%d:%d:%v:%s",r.Off,r.Siz,r.Type,r.Sym.Name))}
 out=append(out,"track:"+UP.TrackSym(noalg,noalg.Field(0)).Name)

 // All migrated metadata helpers: derive static symbols and preserve existing dictionary expressions.
 integer:=TY.Types[types.TINT];slice:=TY.NewSlice(integer);m:=TY.NewMap(TY.Types[types.TSTRING],integer);ch:=TY.NewChan(integer,types.Cboth)
 value:=func(name string,typ *types.Type)ir.Node{return GRAPH.NewNameAt(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup(name),typ)}
 sv,mv,iv:=value("slice",slice),value("map",m),value("integer",integer)
 iface:=value("iface",TY.NewInterface(nil));cached:=UP.TypePtrAt(pos,foreign)
 check:=func(label string,read func()ir.Node,set func(ir.Node)){n:=read();out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("helper:%s:%s:%v:%d",label,n.(*ir.AddrExpr).X.(*ir.LinksymOffsetExpr).Linksym.Name,n.Type(),n.Typecheck()));set(cached);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("cached:%s:%t",label,read()==cached))}
 appendNode:=GRAPH.NewCallExpr(pos,ir.OAPPEND,nil,[]ir.Node{sv,iv});appendNode.SetType(slice);check("append",func()ir.Node{return UP.AppendElemRType(pos,appendNode)},func(n ir.Node){appendNode.RType=n})
 for _,left:=range []bool{false,true}{x,y:=iv,iface;if left{x,y=y,x};n:=GRAPH.NewBinaryExpr(pos,ir.OEQ,x,y);check(fmt.Sprint("compare",left),func()ir.Node{return UP.CompareRType(pos,n)},func(v ir.Node){n.RType=v})}
 conv:=GRAPH.NewConvExpr(pos,ir.OCONVIFACE,iface.Type(),iv);check("conv",func()ir.Node{return UP.ConvIfaceSrcRType(pos,conv)},func(n ir.Node){conv.SrcRType=n})
 cp:=GRAPH.NewBinaryExpr(pos,ir.OCOPY,sv,sv);check("copy",func()ir.Node{return UP.CopyElemRType(pos,cp)},func(n ir.Node){cp.RType=n})
 del:=GRAPH.NewCallExpr(pos,ir.ODELETE,nil,[]ir.Node{mv,iv});check("delete",func()ir.Node{return UP.DeleteMapRType(pos,del)},func(n ir.Node){del.RType=n})
 index:=GRAPH.NewIndexExpr(pos,mv,iv);index.SetOp(ir.OINDEXMAP);check("index",func()ir.Node{return UP.IndexMapRType(pos,index)},func(n ir.Node){index.RType=n})
 for _,entry:=range []struct{op ir.Op;typ *types.Type}{ {ir.OMAKECHAN,ch},{ir.OMAKEMAP,m},{ir.OMAKESLICE,slice},{ir.OMAKESLICECOPY,slice} }{
 n:=GRAPH.NewMakeExpr(pos,entry.op,nil,nil);n.SetType(entry.typ)
 read:=func()ir.Node{switch entry.op{case ir.OMAKECHAN:return UP.MakeChanRType(pos,n);case ir.OMAKEMAP:return UP.MakeMapRType(pos,n);default:return UP.MakeSliceElemRType(pos,n)}}
 check(fmt.Sprint(entry.op),read,func(v ir.Node){n.RType=v})
 }
 rng:=GRAPH.NewRangeStmt(pos,nil,nil,mv,nil,false);check("range",func()ir.Node{return UP.RangeMapRType(pos,rng)},func(n ir.Node){rng.RType=n})
 unsafeSlice:=GRAPH.NewBinaryExpr(pos,ir.OUNSAFESLICE,iv,iv);unsafeSlice.SetType(slice);check("unsafeSlice",func()ir.Node{return UP.UnsafeSliceElemRType(pos,unsafeSlice)},func(n ir.Node){unsafeSlice.RType=n})

 // Preserve native caches, named runtime IR, zero-sized entries and indirect keys/elements.
 for _,typ:=range []*types.Type{UP.MapType(),UP.mapTableType(),UP.MapIterType()}{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("runtime:%v:%d:%d",typ,typ.Size(),typ.Alignment()));for _,f:=range typ.Fields(){out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("field:%s:%v:%d",f.Sym.Name,f.Type,f.Offset))}}
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("cache:%t:%t:%t",UP.MapType()==UP.MapType(),UP.MapIterType()==UP.MapIterType(),UP.MapIterType().Field(3).Type.Elem()==UP.MapType()))
 for _,split:=range []bool{false,true}{EXPERIMENT.MapSplitGroup=split
 for _,entry:=range []struct{key,elem *types.Type}{ {integer,TY.Types[types.TUINT8]},{TY.NewStruct(nil),TY.NewStruct(nil)},{TY.NewArray(TY.Types[types.TUINT8],129),TY.NewArray(integer,129)},{TY.Types[types.TSTRING],TY.NewSlice(integer)} }{
 typ:=TY.NewMap(entry.key,entry.elem);group:=UP.MapGroupType(typ)
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("group:%t:%v:%v:%d:%d:%t:%t:%t",split,typ,group,group.Size(),group.Alignment(),group==UP.MapGroupType(typ),group.StructType().Map==typ,group.Noalg()))
 for _,f:=range group.Fields(){out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("gfield:%s:%d:%d:%t",f.Sym.Name,f.Offset,f.Type.Size(),f.Type.Noalg()))}
 }}

 // Full native bit-vector API, including word boundaries and the final partial word.
 for _,n:=range []int32{0,1,31,32,33,65}{
 a,b,dst:=bitvec.New(n),bitvec.New(n),bitvec.New(n)
 for i:=int32(0);i<n;i++{if i%2==0{a.Set(i)};if i%3==0{b.Set(i)}}
 emit:=func(label string,v bitvec.BitVec){var indexes []int32;for i:=v.Next(0);i>=0;i=v.Next(i+1){indexes=append(indexes,i)};out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("bits:%d:%s:%s:%d:%t:%v:%x",n,label,v.String(),v.Count(),v.IsEmpty(),indexes,v.B))}
 emit("a",a);emit("b",b);dst.Or(a,b);emit("or",dst);dst.And(a,b);emit("and",dst);dst.AndNot(a,b);emit("andnot",dst);dst.Copy(a);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("eq:%d:%t",n,dst.Eq(a)));dst.Not();emit("not",dst);dst.Clear();emit("clear",dst)
 if n>0{a.Unset(n-1);emit("unset",a)}
 bulk:=bitvec.NewBulk(n,2);x,y:=bulk.Next(),bulk.Next();if n>0{x.Set(n-1)};emit("bulk1",x);emit("bulk2",y)
 }
 // Native GC scan rules and deferred symbol emission.
 p:=TY.NewPtr(integer)
 record:=TY.NewStruct([]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,nil,p),TY.NewField(pos,nil,integer),TY.NewField(pos,nil,TY.NewInterface(nil)),TY.NewField(pos,nil,TY.NewSlice(p))})
 nonheap:=TY.NewStruct([]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,nil,p)});nonheap.SetNotInHeap(true)
 cases:=[]*types.Type{integer,p,TY.Types[types.TUNSAFEPTR],TY.Types[types.TSTRING],TY.NewInterface(nil),TY.NewSignature(nil,nil,nil),m,ch,TY.NewSlice(p),record,TY.NewArray(record,3),TY.NewArray(p,0),TY.NewArray(p,128),TY.NewArray(p,129),TY.NewPtr(nonheap)}
 for _,typ:=range cases{
 TY.CalcSize(typ);bv:=bitvec.New(int32(typ.Size()/int64(target.size))+3);typebits.Set(typ,int64(target.size),bv)
 noCheck:=bitvec.New(bv.N);typebits.SetNoCheck(typ,int64(target.size),noCheck)
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("scan:%v:%s:%t",typ,bv.String(),bv.Eq(noCheck)))
 for _,allow:=range []bool{false,true}{sym,n:=UP.GCSym(typ,allow);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("gcreg:%v:%t:%s:%d:%t:%d",typ,allow,sym.Name,n,sym.OnList(),len(sym.P)))}
 }
 UP.WriteGCSymbols()
 snapshotGC:=func(s *obj.LSym){out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("gcdata:%s:%v:%d:%d:%x:%v:%t",s.Name,s.Type,s.Size,s.Align,s.P,uint32(s.Attribute),s.OnList()))}
 for _,s:=range LINK.Data{snapshotGC(s)}
 count:=len(LINK.Data);UP.WriteGCSymbols();out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("gc-repeat:%t",count==len(LINK.Data)))
 large:=TY.NewArray(p,129);cell,demand,n:=UP.dgcsym(large,true,true);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("ondemand:%t:%d",demand,n));snapshotGC(cell)
 var zeroSym *obj.LSym
 for _,size:=range []int64{0,8,1,128,64}{z:=UP.ZeroAddr(size).(*ir.AddrExpr);sym:=z.X.(*ir.LinksymOffsetExpr).Linksym;if zeroSym==nil{zeroSym=sym};out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("zero:%d:%d:%s:%t:%v:%d",size,UP.ZeroSize,sym.Name,sym==zeroSym,z.Type(),z.Typecheck()))}
 queue:=append([]typeAndStr(nil),UP.signatslice...);slices.SortFunc(queue,typesStrCmp)
 for _,ts:=range queue{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("queued:%s:%s",ts.short,ts.regular))}
 encoded,err:=json.Marshal(out);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};fmt.Println("SYNCGO_IR="+string(encoded))
}
